mechanism: A discontinuous price move can be either informed continuation or temporary overreaction. The hypothesized payer is liquidity demand that crosses a depleted book and inventory-bearing liquidity providers that subsequently replenish or retreat. The edge, if any, must come from identifying the post-jump liquidity-state transition rather than from a generic momentum or oscillator threshold.
entry_event: An observable price/range jump occurs while contemporaneous L2 depth, spread and bid/ask quantity state changes from its pre-event liquidity state. The event definition must use only information available at the decision timestamp and must be frozen before economic evaluation.
direction_rule: Classify continuation versus reversal from the sign of the observed jump together with whether same-side book depletion persists or liquidity replenishes/opposes the jump. Direction is an event-state rule, not an indicator crossover and not a fitted PnL threshold.
horizon: The causal horizon is the short microstructure interval over which book depletion, adverse selection and inventory replenishment resolve. A concrete evaluation horizon may be frozen only from an event-response/market-structure study before PnL inspection; it must not be selected by return maximization.
regime_owner: Operate only when OHLCV, volume and synchronized L2 are complete and fresh enough for the frozen event contract. Do not operate when L2 is stale, crossed, incomplete, source lineage is discontinuous, the prospective-history gate is unset, or the event cannot be distinguished from ordinary noise without fitted thresholds.
invalidation: Invalidate the architecture-level directional hypothesis when the expected liquidity response fails to persist or the book response moves into the opposite pre-registered state. Missing or inconsistent source state invalidates the observation rather than creating a proxy signal.
exit_logic: Exit logic must be tied to resolution of the liquidity-state hypothesis: depletion/replenishment resolution, architecture invalidation, or the separately frozen causal time horizon. Stop/target geometry is not specified or tuned in this preregistration.
time_stop: A time stop is required because a microstructure information advantage should decay as liquidity replenishes. Its concrete duration must be frozen before economic replay from the causal event-response study, not optimized against PnL.
turnover_cost_budget: The candidate is viable only if its short signal half-life can dominate BingX taker/maker fees, spread crossing, slippage, latency and applicable funding. No trade-deletion or turnover reduction may be called improvement unless net economics remain positive under the later deterministic gates.
symbol_side_scope: Initial source scope is BTC-USDT and ETH-USDT perpetuals, both directions as research hypotheses. Long and short behavior must be attributed separately before any survivor decision.
risk_geometry: No leverage, sizing, stop distance or target distance is authorized here. Tail risks include gap/jump continuation, liquidation cascades, book evaporation, crossed/stale books, adverse-selection spikes and latency between observation and fill.
execution_assumptions: Decision-time book observations must precede fills; no future depth may be used. Later economic replay must include spread, fee, slippage, latency, partial-fill/reject assumptions where available and must preserve source/config/window lineage.
falsification_test: Freeze one event-state taxonomy and one causal horizon without PnL tuning. On prospective synchronized OHLCV/volume/L2 observations, continuation-state events must show the pre-registered same-sign response while replenishment-state events show the pre-registered opposite-sign response after all modeled costs; failure of the sign separation, positive net expectancy requirement, source integrity, or cross-symbol/regime robustness kills this architecture for the tested corpus rather than triggering threshold rescue.
